apple_books.accepted_format: EPUB; EPUB 3.3 supported; fixed layout supported
apple_books.cover_requirement: RGB high-quality JPEG/PNG; at least 1400 px on shorter axis
apple_books.metadata_requirement: title, author, language, Vendor ID and accurate customer-facing metadata; book file, cover and metadata must agree
apple_books.identifier_requirement: Vendor ID required; ISBN optional and should match Vendor ID when supplied
apple_books.validation_requirement: latest EPUBCheck plus Apple Books preview/submission validation
apple_books.fixed_layout_support: EPUB 3 pre-paginated; consistent viewport; landmarks required when Apple-generated sample is used
apple_books.file_size_boundary: ideally below 1 GB; Apple allows up to 2 GB
apple_books.account_submission_boundary: active Free or Paid Books Agreement and iTunes Connect/Publishing Portal action required

google_play_books.accepted_format: EPUB and PDF; EPUB 3.3 preferred; fixed-layout EPUB supported
google_play_books.cover_requirement: JPEG, PNG, TIFF or PDF accepted in the single-book workflow; content/cover naming follows book identifier
google_play_books.metadata_requirement: book settings, genre, contributors, description, territories and price are supplied in Partner Center
google_play_books.identifier_requirement: ISBN is not required; Partner Center can issue a GGKEY
google_play_books.validation_requirement: EPUBCheck and review as a Content Reviewer in Web Reader and, where possible, Android tablet app
google_play_books.fixed_layout_support: supported in EPUB 2/3; original-page PDF can be paired with EPUB
google_play_books.file_size_boundary: no universal ebook maximum stated in the cited official snapshot; processing status is authoritative after upload
google_play_books.account_submission_boundary: Partner Center account, sales territories, payment profile, tax/bank and publish action remain manual

kobo_writing_life.accepted_format: EPUB accepted; fixed-layout EPUB is supported
kobo_writing_life.cover_requirement: portrait JPG/JPEG preferred or PNG; no larger than 5 MB; 300 DPI recommended; 3:4 suggested
kobo_writing_life.metadata_requirement: title, subtitle, series, series number, language, synopsis, categories and rights/distribution fields
kobo_writing_life.identifier_requirement: ISBN optional for Kobo direct; Kobo issues its own identifier, though partner distribution may require ISBN
kobo_writing_life.validation_requirement: error-free EPUB; test at least one eReader/desktop app and one phone/tablet; fixed-layout side-load suffix .fxl.kepub.epub
kobo_writing_life.fixed_layout_support: supported, but fixed-layout titles do not receive Kobo Instant Preview
kobo_writing_life.account_submission_boundary: KWL account, rights, DRM, territories, pricing and publish action remain manual

amazon_kdp.accepted_format: EPUB or KPF for fixed-layout ebooks; MOBI is no longer accepted for fixed-layout ebooks
amazon_kdp.cover_requirement: separate marketing cover; 2560 × 1600 px recommended, at least 300 PPI, JPEG preferred, 5 MB or less
amazon_kdp.metadata_requirement: title/series/author on cover must match KDP metadata; categories, territories, pricing and rights are manual fields
amazon_kdp.identifier_requirement: ISBN is not required for Kindle ebooks; Amazon assigns an ASIN
amazon_kdp.validation_requirement: Kindle Previewer/Kindle Create preview; comic fixed-layout metadata and panel behavior must be checked
amazon_kdp.fixed_layout_support: graphic novels use fixed layout with image pop-ups/Panel View or Virtual Panels; book-type comic and original-resolution metadata required
amazon_kdp.file_size_boundary: no single maximum asserted by this snapshot; cover limit above is explicit
amazon_kdp.account_submission_boundary: KDP account, rights declaration, marketplace, price/royalty, preview and publish action remain manual
